Teenage Naga Youth Shot Dead in Manipur Ambush

A 15 or 17-year-old Naga youth was shot dead in an ambush in Manipur's Tamenglong district. The incident occurred around 10:05 am when the boy, identified as Nk Wiphenbou of Nkou Naga village, was walking alone from Upper Nkou to Malek village. Suspected militants or unknown armed individuals are believed to be responsible.
